provenance.prompt: Create one clean production game character cutout of FOLI, strictly the first/smallest hare at far left of the approved lineup. Preserve warm olive-brown fur, cream muzzle/throat/paws, one upright leaf ear and one leaf ear swept left, amber eye, leaf tail, seated alert right-facing slightly elevated side view with forepaws near chest. Exactly three detached blade leaves in front of forepaws/face. Match hand-painted cel-shaded fantasy reference, dark outline, organic leaf texture, warm highlights and olive shadows. Fully visible with transparent alpha, no text, scenery, shadow ellipse, clothing, weapons or duplicate creatures.
